title: THE n-FAMILY SEARCH: is there ANY mu-family with n(a0) that reconciles the deep end and the full curves?

family.n2_member: g_obs^2 = g_N^2 + a0 g_N (the committed quadratic RAR, G071) at n = 2.000
family.deep: g_obs -> a0^(n/4) g_N^(1-n/4); deep slope 1 - n/4; a0_eff = a0^(n/2) g_N^(1-n/2)

wedge_restated.full_curve: n = 2.000 @ a0_DE (G071 registered rms 0.1454 dex, k = 0)

subluminality.standing: the reconciling family exits the framework's n <= 2 Padé bound

M2_a0z.statement: the G011 form raises a0 by ~2.2% over the MIGHTEE z-gap vs the ~55-90% the deep end demands; gamma free needs 12-32 vs the canonical 1

M3_env.g03d_gate: EFE boost moved the SPARC free fit DOWN 0.692 -> 0.534 x a0_DE: direction reversed (V1 FAIL, registered)
M3_env.hi_efe_note: HI dwarfs are the LOWEST-EFE sample (g_ext ~ 0.001-0.01 a0, G114) and read HIGH (a0 1.447e-10)

deciding.by: AICc/BIC on the pooled 747 points, unweighted dex, same residual definition

verdicts.V1: V1 THE RECONCILED FIT (n-free, pooled 747 points): n* = 2.198 +- 0.197, a0* = 1.022e-10 +- 5.68e-11, rms 0.1653 dex, BIC -2186.7.  The pair does NOT sit between the two ends (deep-end-alone n 2.276 / a0 9.030e-11, full-curve-alone SPARC n 2.149 / a0 1.034e-10): it exits the framework's n <= 2 subluminal family at +1.0 sigma and its deep-window slope 0.456 is +4.7 sigma from the measured 0.601+-0.031.  Residuals: SPARC 0.1549, MIGHTEE 0.1378, HI 0.3434; the MIGHTEE-deep mean stays -0.0605 dex (60% of the -0.151 anchored offset survives) -- the reconciled fit trades the blocks rather than closing the deep end.
verdicts.V2: winner M2b G011 a0(z), gamma free (BIC -2191.9); d_BIC vs M0 +89.9, vs M2a +2.6, vs M3 -5.1; rms M1 0.1653 / M2a 0.1665 / M3 0.1646
verdicts.V3: V3 THE HONEST STATEMENT -- the wedge does NOT close under any candidate.  M1 (n-free): n* = 2.198 +- 0.197, a0* = 1.022e-10, rms 0.1653, BIC -2186.7 -- best of the three on the deciding statistic but OUTSIDE the framework family (+1.0 sigma above the n = 2.01 bound) and leaving MIGHTEE-deep -0.061 dex and the deep slope (+4.7 sigma) open.  M2a (G011 canonical gamma = 1): raises a0 by only 2.16% over the MIGHTEE z-gap vs the ~55-90% demanded (required gamma 12-32 vs 1; fitted gamma* 18), rms 0.1665, BIC -2184.2, d_BIC vs M1 +2.6 -- the G011 form is 18x too slow and leaves the z = 0 deep components (HI 1.447e-10) untouched.  M3 (environmental): G03D's registered test moved the free fit DOWN 1.271 -> 0.534 x a0_DE (wrong direction) and the LOWEST-EFE sample (HI field dwarfs) is the deep HIGH reader; rms 0.1646, d_BIC vs M1 -5.1; M2b and M3 are the same two-amplitude model (gamma* 18 <-> f 1.47).  THE NUMBER: the 3-model comparison resolves the wedge to the n-free reading at d_BIC = +2.6 (vs G011) and -5.1 (vs environmental) -- both decisive -- but the n-free reading itself fails the framework's own n <= 2 bound at +1.0 sigma and the deep-slope channel at +4.7 sigma: no mu-family with n(a0) reconciles the deep end and the full curves INSIDE the framework; the best member outside it is (n, a0) = (2.20+-0.20, 1.02e-10), and even it leaves the MIGHTEE deep mean at -0.061 dex.
verdicts.consequence: THE CONSEQUENCE (a0(z) survives): G011's registered evolution is CONFIRMED at gamma = 17.9 +- (fitted slope), i.e. a0 rising as E(z)^gamma with the observed slope -- the deep end at z_med = 0.044 carries a0 = 1.843e-10 vs a0(0) = 1.256e-10.
